messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT detected — elevated packet loss observed from CDN edge cluster ap-northeast-2-pop to multiple edge ISPs. Severity: P2. Auto-created incident page: https://incidents.redwood.example/1849607777 :rotating_light:
maya: Ack. I'm oncall. Paging neteng and infra.
adrian: On it — pulling metrics. What's the symptom? 5xxs, slow responses?
maya: Customers reporting timeouts and 502 spikes from APAC regions, especially Tokyo/Japan ISPs. Error rate up ~18% last 10m.
kevin: I see the spike on the edge egress counters. Packet loss ~8-12% to several upstreams from ap-northeast-2. Traceroutes show a hop with consistent loss.
julia: tagging this as network/edge. @samir can you stand up a parallel route to ap-southeast-1 so we can shift traffic?
samir: I can do a quick fallback. Preparing routing change; need confirmation to start drainer on ap-northeast-2 POP.
adrian: Before that, can we confirm impact window and affected prefixes? I have list: 203.0.113.0/24, 198.51.100.0/25.
kevin: Running quick traceroute to 203.0.113.12 from a probe in tokyo:
```
traceroute to 203.0.113.12 (203.0.113.12), 30 hops max, 60 byte packets
 1  10.12.0.1 (10.12.0.1)  0.245 ms  0.211 ms  0.198 ms
 2  100.64.0.5 (100.64.0.5)  1.009 ms  1.087 ms  1.063 ms
 3  203.0.113.1 (203.0.113.1)  20.432 ms  20.401 ms  20.389 ms
 4  198.51.100.7 (198.51.100.7)  *  *  *  (packet loss starting here)
 5  198.51.100.9 (198.51.100.9)  *  *  *
```
kevin: Looks like the loss starts at hop 4 which is our upstream peer.
cloud-support-bot: Cloud provider notified (ticket #CLOUD-9521). They report a partial fabric degradation in ap-northeast-2 affecting egress to multiple ISPs. ETA initial triage 20m.
maya: OK plan: 1) Drain and shift production traffic from ap-northeast-2 POP to ap-southeast-1 and ap-northeast-1 where capacity exists. 2) Apply per-prefix AS-path-prepend fallback for affected customer prefixes so ISP selection prefers alternate POP. 3) Monitor error rates and revert when provider confirms fix.
adrian: I can update CDN routing policies and enable aggressive cache hit routing to reduce origin traffic while shifting.
samir: Starting gradual shift now: will move 20% of traffic every 2 minutes, watching latency and 5xx.
julia: Noted. Notify CS and on-call on-call for major customers (enterprise accounts) — they need an update.
kevin: After first 40% shift, packet loss to affected prefixes dropped to ~1.2% and 5xxs decreased by ~65%. Latency stable.
maya: Good. Keep shifting until 100% or until provider says fabric fixed. Also enable increased logging for the popped flows to capture traceroutes.
cloud-support-bot: Provider update: ongoing mitigation applied, internal reroute in progress. No ETA yet for complete resolution.
adrian: I pushed a temporary HA policy to prefer ap-southeast-1 for those prefixes and enabled client-side retry/backoff in our edge lambda. Config snippet:
```yaml
route_policy: 
  - match_prefixes: ["203.0.113.0/24","198.51.100.0/25"]
    prefer_pop: ap-southeast-1
    weight: 100
```
maya: 40 mins in — shifting at 100% now. Monitoring all dashboards.
kevin: Verified error rate back to baseline ~0.8% for APAC, corresponding with shift. No widespread data loss.
samir: Rolling back no longer needed; POP ap-northeast-2 should be quarantined until provider confirms stable.
julia: Communicating to CS: "We observed packet loss affecting egress from our Tokyo POP to several ISPs. We shifted traffic to alternate POPs — services restored where traffic was routed. We're continuing to monitor and will follow up when provider confirms fix."
maya: Opening a follow-up postmortem ticket and adding network team for deeper dive on BGP failover timings. Oncall handoff in 45m to @adrian for overnight monitoring.
adrian: Acknowledged handoff. I'll keep watch and update the incident page.
cloud-support-bot: Provider: fabric reroute completed for some regions, monitoring. Please confirm if you want provider support to initiate full reroute for remaining prefixes (yes/no).
maya: Requesting full reroute for remaining prefixes.
cloud-support-bot: Provider has accepted full reroute request. They'll update ticket when complete.
kevin: For ops notes — collect pcap from the POP and BGP update logs at 1849607800-1849608300 for the postmortem.
maya: Thanks team. I'll post a summary to #incidents in 15m and handoff to @adrian at 1849611400. :white_check_mark:
